subject: Seasonal burst prep: renewal, burst capacity & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ari Chen <ari@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Seasonal burst prep: renewal, burst capacity & QBR scheduling

Hi Ari —

BlueWave's renewal (term ends 2027-09-30) is coming up and I wanted to kick off a short planning thread focused on the upcoming seasonal campaign you mentioned on our last call (expected traffic spike in Nov). High-level asks:

- Confirm anticipated peak QPS and burst duration (rough numbers help us size headroom).
- Discuss a short-term burst plan + contract amendment (temporary credit bucket vs. permanent tier uplift).
- Schedule a focused QBR to align infra, CSM and procurement; propose 60 min in early June.

Attached: draft proposal + mutual action plan (MAP). Laura — I copied legal for the term amendment language and a very light redline if we go with a burst credit overlay. Marissa — can you confirm preferred attendees from CS and operations? Dylan — will need your ops runbook review and an estimate for on-call SRE support pricing.

Proposed QBR windows (PDT):
- Tue June 1, 10:00-11:00
- Wed June 2, 13:00-14:00
- Thu June 3, 09:00-10:00

If those don't work share availability and we'll find a time. Next steps on our side once we agree on timing: update MAP, circulate contract amendment draft, and run an infra sizing pass.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
Attachments: bluewave_proposal_v1.pdf; mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Ari Chen <ari@bluewave.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@bluewave.com>, BlueWave Infrastructure <infra@bluewave.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seasonal burst prep: renewal, burst capacity & QBR scheduling

Thanks Markus — appreciate the proactive kickoff.

Quick answers:
- Peak: we're estimating ~3-4x baseline token volume for a 72-hour run during the campaign window; baseline averages ~1.2M tokens/day.
- Burst duration: planning for 72 hours with two planned ramp periods (start and taper).
- Procurement: I'll loop our procurement contact (cc'ed). Ops: infra team on copy.

QBR windows — June 2 at 13:00 PDT works best for Ari + infra. We'll need a clear view on whether the burst is covered by a one-off credit vs. temporary tier bump (procurement preference is a capped credit model). Also need to understand SLAs for degraded performance handling during the burst — do you support shadow routing / fallback to lower-cost variant if capacity is constrained?

Also, can you include a high-level SRE on-call cost estimate (hourly/day rate) and an ops runbook sample for the burst?

Cheers,
Ari
VP, Platform Engineering | BlueWave Media
ari@bluewave.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ari Chen <ari@bluewave.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seasonal burst prep: renewal, burst capacity & QBR scheduling

Hi Ari + team —

Thanks for the details, Ari. I'll own coordination from the CSM side. A couple quick notes:

- Headcount & staffing: We'll pair a dedicated CSM and an operations lead for the burst window; I suggest a pre-burst drill 2 weeks before go-live to validate KV caches and prefix caching settings.
- Runbook: attaching a trimmed ops runbook and a SOC2 extract for procurement (SOC2 extract attached).
- Attendees for QBR: Markus (AE), Marissa (CSM), Dylan (Ops), Laura (Legal), Ari + infra + procurement. If you want product engineering or analytics, let me know.

I've penciled in June 2, 13:00 PDT. Marking action items below:
1) BlueWave: confirm final peak numbers and any blackout windows (Ari).
2) Redwood: ops sizing + on-call cost estimate (Dylan).
3) Redwood Legal: draft amendment language for burst credits (Laura).
4) Marissa: schedule pre-burst drill and share runbook link.

Marissa Cole
Senior CSM, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: SOC2-extract-2026.pdf; runbook-sample-burst.md

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ari Chen <ari@bluewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Procurement <procure@bluewave.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seasonal burst prep: renewal, burst capacity & QBR scheduling

On Wed, May 19, 2027 at 08:22 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Ari + team —
> 
> Thanks for the details, Ari. I'll own coordination from the CSM side....

I took a quick pass at a lightweight amendment that would add a capped burst credit bucket for the seasonal window and preserve the existing term and core pricing outside of the burst. Draft redline attached. A few notes:

- If procurement prefers credits instead of a temporary tier uplift, we'll need an explicit cap and an overage rate. I've left suggested numbers in the draft but happy to align on the economics in the QBR.
- Please confirm that the operational SLA tolerances are acceptable (we can offer fallback policies and regional routing but not guaranteed absolute capacity beyond committed pools).
- If BlueWave wants an 18-month term in exchange for a lower unit price, that is a separate commercial conversation — flagging as optional.

Attaching: contract-amendment-draft-redline.docx

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Seasonal burst prep: renewal, burst capacity & QBR scheduling

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turns.

Ari — confirmed: June 2, 13:00 PDT for the QBR. I'll send a calendar invite in a separate email with an agenda. For transparency here are the immediate next steps and owners (target dates):

- BlueWave (Ari): finalize peak numbers + blackout windows by May 24.
- Redwood Ops (Dylan): sizing estimate and on-call cost by May 25.
- Redwood Legal (Laura): finalize amendment draft for review by May 26.
- Marissa: set pre-burst drill for week of June 14 and share runbook links by June 1.
- Markus: update MAP and circulate post-QBR action log (June 3).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345 | Draft amendment (DocuSign pending): https://docusign.com/transaction/ABCDEF

If anything changes to the June 2 slot please flag within 24 hours so we can reschedule. Looking forward to aligning and getting the amendment moving so procurement has a path forward.

Best,
Markus
